# Codilated

> Codilated is an AI-first Shopify brand-building and software agency working with brands worldwide, with a special focus on the UAE, the USA and Pakistan. We take e-commerce brands from idea to first sales and build custom software, apps and AI automations that help them scale.

All projects are custom-quoted after a free consultation; Codilated does not publish prices.

## Services
- [Branding & Brand Identity](https://codilated.com/services/branding-design): brand strategy, bilingual Arabic-English logos, visual identity, brand books and packaging
- [Shopify Brand Development](https://codilated.com/services/shopify-ecommerce): Shopify brands from scratch to sales, Arabic storefronts, Tabby and Tamara, migrations, CRO, Shopify Plus
- [Custom Website & App Development](https://codilated.com/services/web-development): websites, web apps, iOS and Android apps, SaaS, custom Shopify apps
- [AI Automation](https://codilated.com/services/ai-automation): AI agents, WhatsApp and web chatbots, voice agents, workflow automation
